desc:
📦 A relaxing game about sorting boxes in a warehouse.

-- CONTROLS --
💻 Computer:
LeftCtrl - Free mouse
E - Pick Up / Place Down
Q - Settings
R - Tutorial Guide
C - Upgrades
F - Gamepass Shop
1 and 2 - Abilities
Scroll - Alternate boxes

🎮 Console:
X - Pick Up / Place Down
R1/RB - Settings
Y/△ - Tutorial Guide
L1/LB - Upgrades
L2/LT - Gamepass Shop
DPad - Abilities and alternate boxes

LIKE 👍 and FAVORITE ⭐ the game for more updates!

-- Patch update 9/15/26 --
- Fixed boxes being missing when teammate leaves
- Fixed dollies and stairs not stopping
- Fixed scanning ability highlights
- Max boxes on dolly is now 8
- Collision updates
- New wins leaderboard
- New 'Double Jump' pass

Rejoin if you are experiencing any bugs.

⭐ Your progress will always save, so you can leave and come back at any time! ⭐
